earlier_extract:
To ensure our loved ones get the health care they need, we protected funding to public
healthcare invested in projects like the Lethbridge Chinook Regional Hospital, the Calgary
Cancer Centre and the Misericordia Community Hospital modernization project.
Seniors built this province and they deserve to retire in dignity. But many of them can’t find
an affordable place to live with a suitable level of care. That’s why we continue to invest in
building more continuing care beds across the province.
Looking forward, Albertans can count on our government to continue protecting health care
and education.
